task.title: Desktop has no loading screen, slow to paint
task.description:
When first launching the desktop app, if you're signed in but it's been a while since you last opened it so your auth token is probably expired, it takes a long time before the initial app screen loads. In the meantime, there's no loading screen telling the user what's going on.
I'm also not sure it's an auth issue, but it seems to load faster if I've only recently closed the app.
